The Islamic Revolution of 1979 ushered in the regime we see in Iran today. But @aa51_ansari argues that there's another, older revolution that is more vital in understanding contemporary Iran. Part 2 of our interview:

Video

Since the Trump administration launched its war on Iran, critics have accused it of a profound misunderstanding of the country itself. What is Iran's history, and how does it inform the present? I asked the historian @aa51_ansari in Part 1 of our interview:

Video

“The regime is still the same. There are new faces, and these new faces are in the category of uber hawks in Iran.”

That’s what @CrisisGroup’s @AliVaez told me about the mindset of the current Iranian leadership. Our full conversation:

Video

Could the Iran war break the transatlantic alliance for good?

In part 2 of our conversation, I spoke w/ @TheEconomist Editor-in-Chief @zannymb & former State Dept. official under George W. Bush @RichardHaass:

Video

Donald Trump has vowed to strike Iranian power plants and bridges – saying the country would be “living in Hell” – if the Strait of Hormuz, a critical waterway, isn’t opened by Tuesday.

In Part 1 of our conversation, I discussed these threats w/ @CFR_org President Emeritus @RichardHaass & @TheEconomist Editor-in-Chief @zannymb:

Video

So far, President Trump has achieved few of his desired results in Iran, and the geopolitical costs are mounting.

Has any US military action ever racked up so many costs for so few gains?

My take:

Video

On GPS, at 10am & 1pm ET today on @CNN: I’ll talk w/ @CFR_org Pres. As President Trump explores a diplomatic end to the war with Iran, he has also dispatched thousands of additional troops to the Middle East.

I asked ret. Lt. Gen. @MarkHertling what this signals about where the war is headed:

Video

Does the US-Israeli war with Iran violate international law?

That is the question I posed to @rafaelmgrossi, head of the @iaeaorg and a candidate for the next UN Secretary-General. Part 2 of our conversation:

Video

Iran has rejected President Trump's 15-point plan to end the war. At the center of the proposed deal is Iran's nuclear program. What is the status of that program now? I asked @rafaelmgrossi of the @iaeaorg in Part 1 of our conversation:

Video

Donald Trump called Barack Obama’s Syria “red line” reversal “a disaster.”

But Obama’s red line flip-flop looks like the model of careful policymaking compared to Trump’s many about-faces during the Iran war.

My take:

Video

On GPS, at 10am & 1pm ET today on @CNN: What would it take for Pres. Trump to reach an agreement with Iran? I’ll discuss w/ International Atomic Energy Agency Director General @rafaelmgrossi. I’ll also talk w/ retired US Army Lt. Gen. @MarkHertling about recent troop deployments to the Middle East, @AzadehMoaveni about Iranian diaspora politics and @tristanharris about the week’s landmark court rulings on social media
